# vLLM Omni Review Skill

The canonical review skill lives in `vllm-project/vllm-omni` at
`.claude/skills/review-pr/SKILL.md`. The shared
[maintenance SOP](../skills/repository-maintenance/SKILL.md) applies the
[vLLM Omni overlay](../skills/repository-maintenance/references/projects/vllm-omni/review.md)
and loads that source through [repository-review-source](../skills/repository-review-source/SKILL.md).
The project sync script installs these resources, not a second maintained review
checklist. Inspect the source checkout and record the actual version read.
